## Store policies

- Shipping & Delivery (https://theshopnest.xyz/pages/shipping-policy/): Delivery in 2–4 working days anywhere in Pakistan. Rs 199 delivery fee; free on orders of Rs 1,999 or more.
- Returns, Replacement & Refunds (https://theshopnest.xyz/pages/returns-policy/): Free replacement within 7 days of delivery for damaged, faulty or wrong items (an unboxing video is required). Orders can be cancelled free of charge any time before dispatch.
- FAQ (https://theshopnest.xyz/pages/faq/): Answers about ordering, payment, delivery, replacements and order tracking.
- Privacy Policy (https://theshopnest.xyz/pages/privacy-policy/): What customer information is stored and who it is shared with (couriers only).
- Terms of Service (https://theshopnest.xyz/pages/terms-of-service/): Terms for orders, prices, payment, delivery and cancellations.
- About ShopNest (https://theshopnest.xyz/pages/about-us/): Who we are: an online store based in Lahore that delivers nationwide.
- Contact (https://theshopnest.xyz/contact/): WhatsApp or call +923284430589, or email shopnest260@gmail.com.
- Track an order (https://theshopnest.xyz/track-order/): Check order status with an Order ID (e.g. SN-12345) or the phone number used to order.
- Payment: Cash on Delivery (Rs 99 COD fee) or JazzCash / bank transfer (no COD fee — save Rs 99).

## Buying guides

### Best Wireless Earbuds in Pakistan Under Rs 3,500 (2026 Buying Guide)

- URL: https://theshopnest.xyz/buying-guides/best-wireless-earbuds-pakistan/
- Recommended products: Air Pro 2nd Gen Wireless Earbuds (Without Box) (Rs 1,750, https://theshopnest.xyz/products/air-pro-2nd-gen-earbuds-without-box/); W161 TWS Earbuds ANC + ENC (Rs 2,000, https://theshopnest.xyz/products/w161-tws-earbuds-anc-enc/); FDl FD1-TWS 66 Wireless Earbuds (Rs 2,499, https://theshopnest.xyz/products/fdl-fd1-tws-66-earbuds/); G-Golden GB-03 Open-Ear Wireless Earphones (Rs 2,999, https://theshopnest.xyz/products/g-golden-gb-03-open-ear-wireless-earphones/); Ulex UX-1 Wireless Gaming Earbuds (Rs 2,099, https://theshopnest.xyz/products/ulex-ux-1-wireless-gaming-earbuds/); Air Pro 2nd Gen Wireless Earbuds (With Box) (Rs 1,999, https://theshopnest.xyz/products/air-pro-2nd-gen-earbuds-with-box/)

Quick answer: For most people, the Air Pro 2nd Gen (Without Box) at Rs 1,750 is the best value. If you take lots of calls on noisy roads, get the W161 ANC + ENC. If battery life matters most, the FDl FD1 gives up to 45 hours with its case. Can't stand in-ear buds? The clip-on G-Golden GB-03 is the most comfortable.

FAQs:
- Q: Are cheap earbuds bad for your ears?
  A: Volume matters more than price. Keep volume around 60% and take breaks; noise-cancelling models like the W161 let you listen at lower volume in noisy places.
- Q: Do these earbuds work with iPhone?
  A: Yes. Every pair in this guide pairs over Bluetooth with both iPhone and Android phones.
- Q: What is the difference between ANC and ENC?
  A: ANC reduces the noise you hear while listening. ENC reduces the background noise the other person hears during a call.
- Q: Can I check the earbuds before paying?
  A: You pay the rider when the parcel arrives (Cash on Delivery). If anything is faulty, send us your unboxing video within 7 days and we replace it free.

### Load-Shedding Survival Kit: Power Banks, Emergency Bulbs & Backup Light (2026)

- URL: https://theshopnest.xyz/buying-guides/load-shedding-essentials/
- Recommended products: WEGO WG-611 Rechargeable LED Bulb (Rs 1,199, https://theshopnest.xyz/products/wego-wg-611-rechargeable-led-bulb/); OKNEW Emergency LED Bulb 5W (Rs 1,099, https://theshopnest.xyz/products/oknew-emergency-led-bulb-5w/); G-Golden GP-07 Power Bank 30000mAh 22.5W (Rs 6,999, https://theshopnest.xyz/products/g-golden-gp-07-power-bank-30000mah/); Orange Braided USB-C Cable with SIM Pin (Rs 299, https://theshopnest.xyz/products/orange-braided-usb-c-cable-with-sim-pin/)

Quick answer: For light, get the WEGO WG-611 if your outages are long (up to 9.5 hours on low) or the OKNEW 5W for shorter cuts (3–4 hours). For your phone, the G-Golden GP-07 30,000mAh charges a typical phone several times and has cables built in. Total kit: under Rs 9,500 — far less than a UPS.

FAQs:
- Q: Do I need to switch the emergency bulb on during a power cut?
  A: Leave the wall switch ON all the time. The bulb charges while electricity is on and lights up automatically from its battery when the power goes.
- Q: How many times will a 30,000mAh power bank charge my phone?
  A: Roughly four or more full charges for a typical 4,000–5,000mAh phone, depending on the phone and cable.
- Q: Can I charge the WEGO bulb from a power bank?
  A: Yes — it has a Type-C port, so you can charge it from any USB charger or power bank.
- Q: Is a power bank safe to leave charging overnight?
  A: The GP-07 has overcharge, overheating and short-circuit protection. As with any battery, keep it on a hard surface away from heat.

### How to Choose a WiFi Security Camera for Your Home or Shop in Pakistan

- URL: https://theshopnest.xyz/buying-guides/wifi-security-camera-buying-guide/
- Recommended products: V380 WiFi Camera HD Wireless IP (Rs 3,999, https://theshopnest.xyz/products/v380-wifi-camera-hd-wireless-ip/); V380 BK-530 Mini Battery WiFi Camera (Rs 4,300, https://theshopnest.xyz/products/v380-bk-530-mini-battery-wifi-camera/)

Quick answer: Choose the V380 WiFi Camera (Rs 3,999) for a fixed spot like a room, gate view or shop counter — it has night vision, motion alerts and two-way audio. Choose the V380 BK-530 (Rs 4,300) if you need to move it around or place it where there's no socket — it has a built-in battery. Both work with the free V380 app.

FAQs:
- Q: Does a WiFi camera need internet all the time?
  A: Yes, to view it from your phone. Without internet, it can still record to a memory card if one is installed.
- Q: Will it work with 5GHz WiFi?
  A: Use the 2.4GHz network — most routers broadcast both. 2.4GHz also reaches further through walls.
- Q: Can I watch the camera from abroad?
  A: Yes. As long as the camera is online, you can watch from anywhere in the world through the V380 app.
- Q: Is it legal to use a camera at home or in my shop?
  A: Cameras in your own home or shop are common. Avoid pointing them into neighbours' private spaces and let staff know if they're being recorded.

### Which Hair Brush Is Right for You? A Simple Guide by Hair Type

- URL: https://theshopnest.xyz/buying-guides/hair-brush-guide/
- Recommended products: Vented Detangling Hair Brush (Rs 329, https://theshopnest.xyz/products/vented-detangling-hair-brush/); Teardrop Detangling Hair Brush (Rs 279, https://theshopnest.xyz/products/teardrop-detangling-hair-brush/); Cushion Paddle Hair Brush (Rs 449, https://theshopnest.xyz/products/cushion-paddle-hair-brush/); Round Styling Hair Brush (Rs 310, https://theshopnest.xyz/products/round-styling-hair-brush/); XC-901 Magnetic Oil Dispensing Massage Comb (Rs 3,499, https://theshopnest.xyz/products/xc-901-magnetic-oil-dispensing-massage-comb/)

Quick answer: Tangles and wet hair: Vented Detangling Brush. Kids or sensitive scalp: Teardrop Detangling Brush. Long, thick hair and shine: Cushion Paddle Brush. Volume and curls when blow-drying: Round Styling Brush. Weekly oiling without the mess: XC-901 Oil Dispensing Massage Comb.

FAQs:
- Q: Should I brush my hair wet or dry?
  A: Both are fine with the right brush. For wet hair, use a flexible detangling brush (Vented or Teardrop) and start from the ends.
- Q: How often should I clean my hair brush?
  A: Remove loose hair every few days and wash the brush with mild shampoo and water every 1–2 weeks.
- Q: Which brush is best for curly hair?
  A: A flexible detangling brush like the Vented or Teardrop works through curls gently, ideally on damp hair with conditioner.
- Q: How often should I oil my hair?
  A: Once or twice a week suits most people. Apply to the scalp, massage, and wash out after a few hours or the next morning.
